2024-06-08
Claimant reported a side impact at an intersection and stated the other vehicle entered from the left while the claimant
had the green light. The claimant reports a concussion and is not represented by counsel.
2024-06-18
Reviewed the scene photos and the vehicle damage, which are mostly in line with the described impact. The
claimant's account has been consistent so far.
2024-09-12
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the collision happened as the claimant described. Two independent
witnesses gave statements that match the sequence of events.
2024-09-23
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of
coverage. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
2024-10-26
Claimant has been asked where they were seated at impact, and the answer is still unclear. The seating position will
need to be clarified before the injury analysis is finalized.
2024-11-07
Claimant provided a few additional details on a follow-up call. The core account of the crash remained the same as
the first report.
2024-11-10
Medical records show the concussion treatment followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimant improved.
No prior injury to the same body area is known.
2024-12-16
It is not yet clear whether the concussion was caused by this crash, so the injury portion stays open pedning further
medical review. The property damage portion is being processed on its own track.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
